player_prompt.intro:
Uri Player {player_id}. Uri kudzana mhirizhonga inonzi Battleship.
Mhaka yako ni kupwaza maships ake mushandi wako kabla awapwaze aako.
Pamusoro pokudzana kwako, unogona kupfura mipondo kwa viwanda vinotevwa kwenye fomati inoteulwa: '[a4]'. Iwapoponda ship, inozivikanwa na 'X'. Iwawanda, inozivikanwa na 'O'. Mumatambudziko aya, mazingira aya ezinoitawo unzwe nokuti waponda.
Mhirizhonga ina matukirwe anopfuza maships ake aya wose.
Bhoja raako rachange rakuwanda ongororo yose yako yakawanda na kuponda kwa mushandi wako, na kuponda kwako na wakawanda kwa mushandi wako pasina kuwanda maships ake.
Ichokoza bhoja raako rachange:
